findings.location: ZZZFeeController._distribute(uint256,address,uint256,bool) (src/ZZZFeeController.sol#133-154) performs a multiplication on the result of a division:
findings.rationale: Division into ten-raw-unit batches intentionally conserves the 5/3/1/1 allocations plus dust below ten raw units; multiplication cannot exceed the funded batch total. Before membership/departure, old dust settles to incumbent owners, including all inbox buckets before global Power changes. This is an explicit economic exception, not universally negligible USD: low-decimal/high-value assets and top-up-triggered settlement require economic admission review.

findings.location: BridgeAssets.assets(Route,BridgeMessage,bool).count (src/libraries/BridgeAssets.sol#12) is a local variable never initialized
findings.rationale: Solidity initializes the local memory struct/integer to zero. Vault._join freshCompound intentionally remains zero for a first LP without an incumbent fee reserve; later membership assigns it from separately harvested designated compounding amounts. Bridge ACK count intentionally remains zero; the Principal/Reward branches set it. Receiver origin explicitly assigns all imported identity/contribution fields and importPending constructs local state. Fee bridge message explicitly assigns the required Reward fields, while ACK/principal-only fields intentionally remain zero; typed receiver checks enforce message kind.

mintDormant forwards exactly the paid 0.05 ETH to the immutable recipient under nonReentrant, reverting NFT issuance/proceeds atomically on failure. Paid-mint tests cover recipient and NFT receiver reentrancy/rejection. A recipient that permanently rejects ETH can permanently prevent minting; select/test the immutable recipient before deployment.
